offending_extra_words: EITHER PARTY'S PAYMENT OR FUNDING OBLIGATIONS EXPRESSLY SET FORTH IN THIS AGREEMENT (INCLUDING ARTICLE 4, ARTICLE 6 AND SECTION 14.2)
FOR THE AVOIDANCE OF DOUBT, THIS SECTION 15.11 IS NOT MEANT TO LIMIT PB'S OBLIGATION TO PAY SFJ THE AMOUNTS SET FORTH IN ARTICLE 6 OR SECTION 14.2.
TOTAL AGGREGATE LIABILITY ARISING OUT OF OR RELATING TO THIS AGREEMENT
reasons: The fee limb anchors the twelve-month look-back to "THE EVENT GIVING RISE TO THE CLAIM" rather than to the claim itself, so the preferred cap basis is not met; change the anchor to "the 12 months preceding the claim".

The preferred requirement that Customer's payment obligations are not "damages" for cap purposes is not expressly stated; the edit instead lists payment/funding obligations as uncapped Excluded Claims, and adds Article 4 funding, broadening scope beyond the position.
The fallback cap of 12 months' fees is exceeded by the US$1,000,000 preferred-only floor, so the fallback bargain is not independently satisfied either.

Minimality fails: the operation replaces the existing final sentence and re-states it, expanding 28 words to 142 (ratio ~5.07, changed-character ratio 0.837). A standalone concise cap insertion, leaving the existing avoidance-of-doubt sentence untouched, would suffice and would avoid duplicating protection for PB's Article 6/14.2 payments.
